title: Doubly robust target inference for generalized linear regression with completely missing covariates
abstract: arXiv:2609.24086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale multipurpose cohort studies and biobanks often omit covariates needed for specific downstream analyses. We study target-population inference for generalized linear regression when key covariates are completely absent from the target data but observed in a related source population. Standard missing covariate methods are not directly applicable because they require at least partial observation of the covariates in the target population. We develop a doubly robust transfer learning framework under a sub-population shift assumption, which allows the distribution of the observed outcome and covariates to differ between populations while requiring the conditional distribution of the missing covariates given the observed variables to be shared. translated_title: 具有完全缺失协变量的广义线性回归的双稳健目标推断
translated_abstract: 大规模多用途队列研究和生物样本库常常缺失特定下游分析所需的协变量。我们研究当关键协变量在目标数据中完全缺失但在相关源人群中被观测到时，广义线性回归的目标人群推断问题。标准的缺失协变量方法无法直接适用，因为它们要求在目标人群中至少部分观测到这些协变量。我们在子人群偏移假设下开发了一个双稳健迁移学习框架，该框架允许观测到的结局变量和协变量的分布在两个人群之间存在差异，同时要求缺失协变量在给定观测变量条件下的条件分布在人群间保持一致。与线性回归不同，非线性目标估计方程需要缺失协变量的参数索引条件泛函，而不是固定的低阶条件矩集合。
tldr: 针对关键协变量在目标数据中完全缺失但可在相关源人群中观测到的情形，本文提出了一种双稳健迁移学习框架，实现广义线性回归的目标人群推断。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a doubly robust transfer learning framework for target-population inference in generalized linear regression when key covariates are completely missing from the target data but observed in a related source population.
